Count on the board (Aziz, 2026-09-16)

Up to 9,999: every digit, no comma (2730, 9999).
10,000 and up: whole thousands, rounded down (12,640 shows 12k).
Only if four digits do not fit the square: one decimal, rounded down (9.9k).
No reading, or zero: the square stays empty.
The number is centred on the digits themselves (measured on the simulator: 0.0px across, 0.5px down).

Goal in this mockup: 8,000. Sat 9,120 green, Sun 3,210 under half, Mon 10,240 blue, Tue 5,480 half, Wed (today) 2,730 so far.

Matching Apple Health

The sheet reads that one day fresh from Apple Health the moment it opens: midnight to midnight, the same merged iPhone + Watch total the Health app shows. The board shows the last reading and refreshes the visible week each time the app opens. Android reads Health Connect the same way.
